title: Senior Sales Manager
must_have: 6+ years of experience in business sales
text:
Senior Sales Manager
Pushkar Trading Group | Full-time | Hybrid, India

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are hiring a senior sales manager to join our business sales team. You will work with cross-functional partners and own outcomes end to end.

MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS:
- Negotiation
- B2B Sales
- Account Management
- Cold Outreach
- Client Presentations
- 6+ years of experience in business sales

NICE-TO-HAVE:
- Market Mapping
- Tender Responses
- Channel Partnerships
- Pipeline Management

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Drive distributor network expansion with measurable outcomes.
- Drive renewal cycle with measurable outcomes.
- Drive festive-season quota delivery with measurable outcomes.
